scientific_summary: Rewritten tags and lyrics condition a dense music LM and acoustic renderer. Optional generated melody or extracted cover melody conditions semantic-token continuation. A separate offline music tokenizer supplies LM targets.
invariants: Text-only inference does not run the music tokenizer. Its dashed targets route lands only in the isolated LLM training footer.
Music semantic tokens are single-codebook 25Hz; melody tokens are distinct 6.25Hz relative-pitch tokens.
The LM is one dense 3B model. Melody-CoT is optional autoregressive planning, not mandatory external preprocessing.
Cover reference melody tokens enter the shared LM prefix; text never enters RMVPE.
Both text and semantic tokens must reach the DiT through their actual Text encoder and semantic inlet.
Render: flow-matching DiT -> acoustic latents -> Spec-VAE decoder -> complex spectrogram -> Band-Mode Refiner -> inverse STFT -> 48kHz stereo.
Training pretraining/SFT/DPO/GSPO is an isolated footer, not an inference loop.
layout: Main inference along one shared horizontal axis: compact text region upper left, larger dense LM centre, taller renderer right. Offline tokenizer lower left enters only LM lower training footer. One smooth short-height overhead text branch, no captions outside frames.
typography: Reference-informed readable dark serif lettering, moderate bold headings. Preserve exact model names. No title background, gradients or underlines.

placements.placement: Separate lower-left offline representation inset; plain encoder and VQ, token marks, offline training caption inside.
Compact white text conditioning region; plain dark request/rewriter/tags labels.
Main central generator; focus on optional Melody-CoT and cover melody prefix; shared dense 3B LM stays whole. Training landing isolated in bottom footer.
White right renderer; semantic tokens and text enter real DiT inlets, then one compact acoustic synthesis sequence.

multi_port_exceptions.condition: Rewritten tags and lyrics independently condition the dense LM and acoustic renderer, as specified in the Qwen report. Two distinct true exits: east to LM and north to renderer text encoder.
multi_port_exceptions.llm: Separate inference tags/lyrics input and offline training-target input; targets land only in isolated footer and do not join inference.
multi_port_exceptions.render: Independent semantic-token input reaches DiT; text input reaches Text encoder and then DiT. Preserve distinct actual ports.
